speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth and SportSG are committed to encouraging Singaporeans to lead active and healthy lifestyles.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: ActiveSG has continually introduced innovative programming at our sports centres, such as Aqua Zumba, Bokwa and Piloxing, and launched various ActiveSG Academies and Clubs to encourage youths and seniors to learn to play different sports.
